concept_uz: Badargʻa qilinganlar oʻqdagi teshiklarda oʻz xonligini quradi: Ildiz-Ikki — xon, Pi — vazir, savdogar E esa murakkab foiz bilan boyiydi — lekin pul hech qachon 2,72 baravarga yetmaydi. Elchi Pi qirol huzuriga keladi: «Biz ham haqiqiy sonlarmiz!» Qirol qiyin savol oldida qoladi.
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm golden light, soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round golden ring-shaped king: a smooth, thick, upright gold ring like a donut standing on its edge, with big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast empty golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty golden plain under a huge sky, a warm sun low on the right horizon and a pale smiling moon with a gentle old woman's face on the left side of the sky, soft morning light, a faint straight line on the ground running from left to right through the centre. No characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A tall, thoughtful teal character with a graceful swan-like curved neck and a flat base, gentle sad eyes, standing inside a glass cage whose front edge is shaped like a large tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). Moody evening light on the golden plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. An elderly scholar character with a round kind face, small spectacles and a long white beard, wearing a deep-blue chapan robe covered in a pattern of circles, holding a coil of measuring rope. He stands beside a wooden cart wheel on the golden plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A lively bazaar merchant character with a curled moustache and a bright embroidered doppi cap, grinning, holding a leather coin purse that is visibly swelling and bulging with gold coins. A colourful market stall on the golden plain behind him, front view, centred.

A strange glowing camp hidden in a deep crack in the golden ground: colourful tents, lanterns, the caged teal character sitting on a simple throne and the elderly scholar standing beside him as vizier, many odd-looking characters around them. Keep both designs exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: The caged teal character rises from the throne and says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad young man's voice: "Endi bizning navbatimiz keldi!" The odd-looking crowd cheers and raises lanterns. No subtitles, no on-screen text.
The merchant shakes his coin purse, which swells bigger and bigger, and says in Uzbek with a quick, smooth bazaar-trader's voice: "Foiz ustiga foiz — boylik shu!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

A small character asks the merchant, says in Uzbek with an excited, high young voice: "Har soniyada qo'shsak-chi?" The purse swells faster and faster — then stops at a certain size, as if hitting an invisible wall. The merchant blinks and says in Uzbek with a quick, smooth bazaar-trader's voice: "Baribir ikki butun yetmish ikkiga yetmaydi!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Baribir ikki butun yetmish ikkiga yetmaydi!

scenes.prompt: In the bright palace, the elderly scholar bows before the ring-king and says in Uzbek with a slow, sleepy elderly professor's voice: "Hazratim! Biz ham haqiqiy sonlarmiz. Talablarimiz bor-yo'g'i uch… bir, to'rt, bir, besh…" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Hazratim! Biz ham haqiqiy sonlarmiz. Talablarimiz bor-yoʻgʻi uch… bir, toʻrt, bir, besh…

scenes.prompt: The scholar keeps listing digits; the ring-king clasps his hands and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Qisqasini ayting!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The merchant bursts through the palace doors with his swelling purse and says in Uzbek with a quick, smooth bazaar-trader's voice: "Hazratim, xazinangizni menga bering, foiz ustiga foiz…" The king and the scholar turn together and both shout, says in Uzbek with the king's and the scholar's voices together, in unison: "Keyin!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Hazratim, xazinangizni menga bering, foiz ustiga foiz…

scenes.prompt: The whole palace bursts out laughing — then falls silent. Every face turns to the ring-king, who stands thinking hard, chin in hand, his crown tilted. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Night under the stars. The ring-king stands alone in the middle of the plain holding his staff, looking toward the dark cracks in the ground where lanterns glow. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a warm storyteller's male voice: "Ular haqiqiymi? Davomi — powerty.uz da." No subtitles, no on-screen text.
